name: lineup-hero
title: Lineup hero
description: A festival or conference poster set in type: the dates and the city as display type, and the names sized by billing, wrapping like a poster.
docs: Pass the festival's title, the dates as you want them set ("12–14 June 2027"), the venue (a city, or { city, name } to set the place small under it) and tiers: an array of { label, names } with the largest billing first, where each name is { name, role?, href? }. The first tier is set largest, the second at half that and every later tier small and quiet. The sizes follow the width of the names' own column, so the poster reflows inside a narrow container as well as on a wide page, and a long name wraps instead of overflowing. Each tier is a heading for screen readers; showTierLabels also writes it on the page, in a column beside the names. A name with an href is a link, and a role is set small after it. ticketsHref and programmeHref add the two buttons. Pass labels to translate the fixed words.
